effect.fr: Tente de capturer un Pokémon sauvage. Le taux de succès augmente de 0.1× (Gén V : 0.3x) à chaque tour, jusqu'à 4× max.
effect.en: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate increases by 0.1× (Gen V: 0.3×) every turn, to a max of 4×.

flavor.en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes progressively more effective at catching Pokémon the more turns that are taken in battle.
flavor.ko: 턴 수가 길어지면 길어질수록 포켓몬을 잡기 쉬운 조금 특이한 볼.
flavor.ja: ターン数が かかれば かかるほど ポケモンが 捕まえやすくなる ちょっと 変わった ボール。
